title: Update styling guide to automatically inline current theme version to download
body: Currently the styling guide refers to a static version of the Algolia theme, we need to be able to inject the last theme version automatically. Which means being able to use variables in the markdown file. This was doable using middleman, unsure with metalsmith how to do it well.
